full_name: Robert A. Simcoe | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Robert A. Simcoe is an associate professor of physics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, where he specializes in observational astrophysics, with a particular emphasis on the chemistry of galaxies and intergalactic matter in the early universe.
